overall_summary: The channel shows a clear preference for 'Husband-Wife' relationship dynamics over generic family or motivational content. The top two performing videos (1770 and 1679 views) focus on marital empathy and communication, significantly outperforming other topics.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos regarding husband-wife dynamics consistently hit 1500+ views, whereas family/general emotional videos average under 300.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos about sisters or general motivation struggle to break 200 views.
weak_patterns.action: Shift focus away from generic family tropes unless they involve specific, high-tension relationship conflicts.
